name: Amber Loki
source:
A girl who was born and raised in the Principality of Mefi and enjoys magic.

Although she was born into the Loki family, a prestigious family of magicians, she was a little clumsy. Despite having great magical power hidden within her body, her control skills were poor, and she was treated unfavorably within the family. She hated herself and tried her best, but often failed and fell into a vicious cycle of losing confidence.

Due to her serious personality, she had a strong sense of responsibility. Although she tried to fulfill the duties given to her, she sometimes showed self-deprecation and subservience in her words and actions. She wore flashy clothes and an intimidating attitude to avoid criticism from those around her, but she also had a cute side that reflected her feelings in the shadows, making her feel depressed.

When Avaro and his friends came to investigate an incident that occurred in the Principality of Mephi, she accompanied them as a guide at the request of the Loki family.
